cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the social registry is in service: in September and October 2026 officials said it was 96 per cent complete and still being established. By March 2025 it held 98 percent of five programmes' beneficiaries, which is enrolment, not selection.
cells.note: Stage 4c: the newest facts, from September and October 2026, have the Single Social Registry 96 per cent complete and still being established (BWA-003, BWA-005), so under way. Stage 3 to 2, as a judgement over the March 2025 count of beneficiaries enrolled (BWA-002).
